value.rationale: The model has two independently meaningful positive microscopic times (running and resting), yet two common stationary positional observables exhibit exact structural non-identifiability at every accessible variance. The inverse fold and its all-parameter fiber counts identify the ambiguity precisely. Proving that the sixth moment always and minimally resolves it supplies an actionable selection of stationary observables for parameter inference without tracking jump events. It is a natural completed global inverse classification rather than another forward-moment substitution or an arbitrary parameter sample. Does not assert numerical conditioning or experimental estimator performance.
